subject: Flumph
fact: The Flumph is a creature that feeds on psychic energy, specifically residual background energies, and releases trauma by dumping memories into the minds of others. It is known for its color-shifting behavior and makes a 'flumph' sound when moving. It is not parasitic like Mind Flayers and avoids evil creatures, which it identifies by their acts of torture, abuse, feeding, or other horrific behaviors.
source_quote: I am a flumph. Or at least that’s what others call us because we make a flumph sound when we move. We feed on the psychic energy of creatures. We aren’t parasitic like the Mind Flayers; we feed on the residual background energies. And we do tend to meet one too many Mind Flayers. And Gith. Only the evil creatures. The evildoers are typically torturing, abusing, feeding, or doing other horrible things.

subject: Droki
fact: Droki is a Derro of habit, whose trail is easy to follow. It is associated with the Cult of Demogorgon and is involved in efforts to transform an egg into a dual-headed dragon mount for its master.
source_quote: We were chasing Droki. The Derro is a creature of habit. Plinki has recently converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and wishes to turn the egg into a dual-headed dragon that he can give to his master to ride!

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki is a Derro who has converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and is attempting to transform an egg into a dual-headed dragon mount. He is working with the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts to summon Demogorgon.
source_quote: Plinki has recently converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and wishes to turn the egg into a dual-headed dragon that he can give to his master to ride!

subject: Whorlstone Caves
fact: The Whorlstone Caves are a complex of underground chambers once used as a hippy gathering place by Derro and Duergar. After the Faerzress blinked and changed, the caves became a war zone between the Cult of Demogorgon and the Empty Scabbard Killers. The main entrance and a side passageway lead to the Obelisk Chamber.
source_quote: The caves were once a hippy place, where Derro and Duergar would come to chill out, party, and be friends. Some months ago, the permanent twilight of the Faerzress stopped, and the cave complex became dark. Everyone was afraid, and the Faerzress blinked on brightly and then was off. And then it blinked once more, and then it returned to its usual color. But something had changed, and soon the various hippy friends stopped being friends. Instead of being a place of friendship, a place where folks could be happy, it became a place of murder and death and conspiracy. The mesa (Area 5) was once a place where folks got together to get drunk and party, but now it was a war zone between the forces of the cult of Demogorgon and the empty scabbard killers.

subject: Obelisk Chamber
fact: The Obelisk Chamber contains a circular pathway and a pyramid-shaped obelisk. It is the site where Plinki is attempting to corrupt an egg into a dual-headed dragon mount. Papers and artifacts related to the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts are present.
source_quote: There you saw it! A chamber with a circular pathway and a pyramid. The one known as Plinki has found this mighty and tasty obelisk and has been trying to make it do something evil.

subject: Council of Savants Chamber
fact: The Council of Savants Chamber is guarded by four individuals and contains the insignia of office of the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts. It is a site of dark ritual and conspiracy tied to the Cult of Demogorgon.
source_quote: Through the side passageway, he sees a chamber with a derro that carries the insignia of office of the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts.

subject: Mind Flayer Hallway
fact: A hallway leads to the lair of a Mind Flayer, which the Flumph avoids by remaining undetected. The hallway is also used by assassins and is near the location where the Duergar Werz was targeted.
source_quote: I survive by not letting mind flayers know I exist. I just know that the Mind Flayer is there, and that the assassins are also there. The ones you said had a magical light blade that tried to kill that duergar Werz.

subject: Mesa (Area 5)
fact: Mesa (Area 5) was once a social hub for Derro and Duergar to party and drink, but after the Faerzress blinked, it became a war zone between the Cult of Demogorgon and the Empty Scabbard Killers.
source_quote: The mesa (Area 5) was once a place where folks got together to get drunk and party, but now it was a war zone between the forces of the cult of Demogorgon and the empty scabbard killers.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is an orc cleric of Bahamut, committed to the principle that dragons have free will and that scale pigmentation does not determine morality. He is determined to save the egg from corruption and believes the Cult of Demogorgon's actions are the greatest evil.
source_quote: As a cleric of Bahamut, I must save the egg. Bahamut is the god of good dragons. He is committed to the principle that dragons have free will and that the pigmentation of their scales doesn’t pre-determine their personality. This idea that chromatic dragons are evil is the greatest evil.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a thoughtful magician and former student of Velkynvelve who practices daily journaling inspired by Milo Goodbarrel. He analyzes factional motivations and negotiates terms with patrons, securing payment and confidentiality agreements for the party’s mission.
source_quote: Daz, a thoughtful magician and long-time student of magic, was inspired by a commentator on Milo Goodbarrel's practice of writing daily. This practice became a regular habit since his escape from Velkynvelve. ... As Daz pens the last paragraph, he smiles. The path forward was clear, and indeed, it was very profitable.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a kin of giants who is wary of all Underdark denizens due to past violence. He prefers escape over confrontation, favors the plan of fleeing on Thermbachaud, and is deeply skeptical of trauma dumping and moral crusades.
source_quote: Everybody we come across here in the Underdark has tried to kill us, so we are wary. ... I still like the plan of escaping on the back of Thermbachaud.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a muttering, pragmatic adventurer who observes and recalls details from Stool’s writings. He is open to the Flumph’s trauma dumps and seeks to extract useful information for the party’s objectives.
source_quote: Stool described myconids and never described them as dancing frantically. ... Perhaps you can tell us where they are?

subject: Gartokkar Xundorn
fact: Gartokkar Xundorn is the leader of the Keepers of the Flame, who seeks proof of the Council of Savants' demonic worship to justify a genocidal war against the Derro. He demands the statue of Demogorgon as evidence and negotiates payment in gold with confidentiality riders.
source_quote: I want proof of the involvement in demonic worship. Bring me the statue of Demogorgon. ... 2000. ... If you betray me, there is no cave, no pool of still water, no river, no place in the dark that I will not find you and hunt you down.

subject: Errde
fact: Errde of the Stone Guards believes the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts are behind the city’s madness and wants physical evidence of their involvement with the Empty Scabbard Killers. She is willing to provide weapons but requires proof to justify action.
source_quote: Errde of the Stone Guards believes the Council of Savants and the Grey Ghosts are behind the increasing madness of the city. She is also pretending not to think that assassins have targeted her clan. She believes that Droki is somehow helping the Council of Savants, and she wants proof of the Council of Savants' involvement with the corruption in the city. She also wants any actual evidence about the Empty Scabbard Killers.

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud is a red dragon who is insecure about his authority and seeks information on the Keepers of the Flame’s plans. He is not convinced of his own control over the Underdark.
source_quote: Themberchaud, the red dragon, believes that the Keepers of the Flame have plans and is not convinced his position is as secure as he wants to believe. More importantly, he’s not sure that he’s in charge. And he wants information about what’s going on.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido was a Flumph who went stark raving mad, possibly due to exposure to psychic energy from the Council of Savants. His fate is referenced by the current Flumph as a cautionary tale.
source_quote: Ever since my friend Buppido went stark raving mad…

subject: Werz
fact: Werz is a Duergar who was targeted by assassins wielding a magical light blade. His attempted murder is known to the Flumph and is cited as evidence of the assassins' presence.
source_quote: The ones you said had a magical light blade that tried to kill that duergar Werz.

subject: Derendil
fact: Derendil was a mad Quagoth, once a polymorphed elf, whose memory is invoked by Zalthir when observing the spore servants.
source_quote: He remembers Prince Derendil, the mad quagoth, who was a polymorphed elf.

subject: Seedy Bar
fact: The seedy bar is where the rest of the crew is holed up. It serves as a base for planning and a potential source of weapons from Errde.
source_quote: We have the rest of the crew holed up in a seedy bar. We could get them weapons from Errde. She was willing to give us a lot of weapons.

subject: Egg
fact: The egg is a mysterious artifact being corrupted by Plinki into a dual-headed dragon mount for Demogorgon. Grygum considers its salvation a divine mandate.
source_quote: Plinki has recently converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and wishes to turn the egg into a dual-headed dragon that he can give to his master to ride!

subject: Statue of Demogorgon
fact: The statue of Demogorgon is the physical proof demanded by Gartokkar Xundorn to justify a genocidal war against the Derro. It is the key bargaining chip in negotiations with the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: I want proof of the involvement in demonic worship. Bring me the statue of Demogorgon.

subject: Insignia of Office
fact: The insignia of office of the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts is carried by a Derro in the Council Chamber, serving as tangible evidence of their authority and involvement in the conspiracy.
source_quote: Through the side passageway, he sees a chamber with a derro that carries the insignia of office of the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts.

subject: Magical Light Blade
fact: A magical light blade was used in an assassination attempt on the Duergar Werz. It is evidence of the assassin’s guild’s presence and activity.
source_quote: The ones you said had a magical light blade that tried to kill that duergar Werz.

subject: Papers in the Obelisk Room
fact: Papers in the Obelisk Room contain writings related to the Council of Savants' plans, though the Flumph cannot recall their contents.
source_quote: Can you tell me what was written on the papers in the obelisk room?" "No.

subject: Cave to the Southwest
fact: The cave to the southwest opens into a natural chamber where myconids and sprouts dance silently. It is the location where Zalthir encounters the myconids and observes their behavior.
source_quote: The cave to the southwest beckons. And so he heads out to see what can be found. The tunnel opens into a natural cave, where several fungi dance to a silent tune. Three are five feet tall, and the others are half as tall.

subject: Myconids
fact: Myconids are sentient fungal beings, some five feet tall, others half as tall. One small myconid stands apart from the rest. They are described by Stool as not dancing frantically.
source_quote: These are myconids. And those little ones are sprouts, like stool. Stool described myconids and never described them as dancing frantically.

subject: Sprouts
fact: Sprouts are juvenile myconids, smaller than their adult counterparts. One stands apart from the rest, suggesting individuality or possible sentience.
source_quote: These are myconids. And those little ones are sprouts, like stool.

subject: Spore Servants
fact: Spore servants are two creatures resembling Quagoths, observed by Zalthir near the myconids. Their appearance suggests a connection to the mad Quagoth Derendil.
source_quote: Behind the myconids are two spore servants; from their looks, they are quagoths.

subject: Cult of Demogorgon Sanctuary
fact: A hidden sanctuary where Plinki and the Council of Savants perform rituals to corrupt the egg into a dual-headed dragon. The sanctuary is protected by the Gray Ghosts and guarded by four individuals.
source_quote: Plinki has recently converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and wishes to turn the egg into a dual-headed dragon that he can give to his master to ride!

subject: Council of Savants
fact: The Council of Savants were once benevolent scholars, but after the Faerzress blinked, they became corrupted and now conspire with Plinki to summon Demogorgon. They are psychics who feed on psychic energy and are enemies of the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: The Council used to be these nice people, and then after the blink, they became crazy. And now they are working with Plinki to try to summon Demogorgon or make him a two-headed dragon mount!

subject: Gray Ghosts
fact: The Gray Ghosts are a secretive organization allied with the Council of Savants. They carry the insignia of office and are involved in the corruption of the egg and the assassination of Duergar Werz.
source_quote: Through the side passageway, he sees a chamber with a derro that carries the insignia of office of the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts.

subject: Empty Scabbard Killers
fact: The Empty Scabbard Killers are an assassin guild active in the Underdark. They are responsible for targeting Duergar Werz and are engaged in a war with the Cult of Demogorgon.
source_quote: The ones you said had a magical light blade that tried to kill that duergar Werz. ... The mesa (Area 5) was once a place where folks got together to get drunk and party, but now it was a war zone between the forces of the cult of Demogorgon and the empty scabbard killers.

subject: Keepers of the Flame
fact: The Keepers of the Flame are a faction dedicated to eliminating the Derro and exposing the Council of Savants. They seek the egg as insurance against Themberchaud and demand proof of demonic worship to justify war.
source_quote: Gartokkar Xundom of the Keepers of the Flame also wants the Grey Ghosts dead. But more importantly, wants the egg. The egg is their insurance policy against Themberchaud. The Keepers of the Flame consider the Council of Savants their worst enemies.

subject: Mind Flayers
fact: Mind Flayers are psychic predators that the Flumph avoids. They are known to be dangerous and are associated with the hallway where the Flumph hides.
source_quote: I survive by not letting mind flayers know I exist. I just know that the Mind Flayer is there... They are quite dangerous!

subject: Duergar
fact: Duergar were once peaceful companions to Derro in the Underdark, but after the Faerzress blinked, they became enemies. Werz was targeted by assassins, indicating internal conflict.
source_quote: The caves were once a hippy place, where Derro and Duergar would come to chill out, party, and be friends.

subject: Derro
fact: Derro were once peaceful hippies in the Underdark, but after the Faerzress blinked, they became violent and were drawn into the Cult of Demogorgon. Plinki and the Council of Savants are now leading them toward genocide.
source_quote: The caves were once a hippy place, where Derro and Duergar would come to chill out, party, and be friends. ... Gartokkar was planning to engage in a genocidal war against the Derro.

subject: Cult of Demogorgon
fact: The Cult of Demogorgon is a corrupting force in the Underdark, led by Plinki, seeking to transform the egg into a dual-headed dragon mount. It is allied with the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: Plinki has recently converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and wishes to turn the egg into a dual-headed dragon that he can give to his master to ride!

subject: Daz's Journal
fact: Daz's journal is a continuous record of his thoughts, analyses, and plans, written daily since his escape from Velkynvelve. It documents factional motivations, negotiations, and the party’s path forward.
source_quote: *As we leave the Derro hovels and re-enter the city of blades, Zalthir’s question of what to do next is pressing. ... As Daz pens the last paragraph, he smiles. The path forward was clear, and indeed, it was very profitable.*

subject: Faerzress
fact: The Faerzress is the magical twilight that once shrouded the Underdark. Its blinking and changes caused societal collapse, turning friendship into violence and peace into war.
source_quote: Some months ago, the permanent twilight of the Faerzress stopped, and the cave complex became dark. Everyone was afraid, and the Faerzress blinked on brightly and then was off. And then it blinked once more, and then it returned to its usual color.

subject: City of Blades
fact: The City of Blades is the surface-level urban center where Daz and the party return after exploring the Underdark. It is a place of intrigue, where Errde and Gartokkar operate.
source_quote: As we leave the Derro hovels and re-enter the city of blades...

subject: Thermbachaud
fact: Thermbachaud is a dragon (likely Themberchaud) that Thorin considers as a means of escape from the Underdark, rather than confronting the cults and factions.
source_quote: I still like the plan of escaping on the back of Thermbachaud.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a reference figure whose writings describe myconids as not dancing frantically. Zalthir uses Stool’s observations to interpret the behavior of the myconids.
source_quote: Stool described myconids and never described them as dancing frantically.

subject: Milo Goodbarrel
fact: Milo Goodbarrel is a writer whose daily journaling practice inspired Daz to begin mentally composing his own journal entries to improve his writing.
source_quote: Daz, a thoughtful magician and long-time student of magic, was inspired by a commentator on Milo Goodbarrel's practice of writing daily.

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: Velkynvelve is the place from which Daz escaped, marking the beginning of his journaling habit and his transformation into a strategic thinker.
source_quote: This practice became a regular habit since his escape from Velkynvelve.

subject: Gartokkar’s Bargain
fact: Gartokkar negotiated a payment of 2000 gold, with an upfront 30% and a confidentiality rider worth 1000 gold, in exchange for retrieving the statue of Demogorgon as proof of demonic worship.
source_quote: 2000. ... First, we secured an upfront payment of 30% of the 2000 gold. Then we secured a confidentiality rider worth another 1000 gold.

subject: Psychic Energy
fact: Psychic energy is the life force that the Flumph feeds on, drawn from the minds of sentient beings, particularly those engaged in violence, fear, or madness.
source_quote: We feed on the psychic energy of creatures. We aren’t parasitic like the Mind Flayers; we feed on the residual background energies.

subject: Trauma Dump
fact: Trauma Dump is the Flumph’s ability to release stored traumatic memories into the minds of others, providing emotional relief for itself but overwhelming its listeners with disturbing visions.
source_quote: I let out all the unpleasant memories inside and into the heroes' minds, and now I feel better! ... Trauma Dump? Why yes! That’s what I do.

subject: Seedy Bar
fact: The seedy bar is where the rest of the crew is holed up. It serves as a base for planning and a potential source of weapons from Errde.
source_quote: We have the rest of the crew holed up in a seedy bar. We could get them weapons from Errde. She was willing to give us a lot of weapons.
